notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It’s time to dive into the tomb! Scoot Kaboom and The Tomb of Doom officially releases on Steam on 1st June 2021!

What started out as a fun idea to make a game take place on one big screen has evolved into an action-filled platformer with over 20 characters to play as and a whole bunch of game modes to conquer and defeat!

Thank you to everyone who’s followed along with the game’s development and we can’t wait for everyone to get to play with Scoot and friends!
